limitations: One host with one settings read per generation and one Stop or visibility interruption. Local test ports verify the host's admission, cancellation, stale error suppression and fresh resume.
Independent host instances, provider write/recovery, device pause failures, settings persistence races, debounce timing, and owner replacement are outside this state projection.
One durable pending cursor, one failing worker, one successful replacement, and one stop. Callback return can be refused if its owner has changed.
Webhook admission and resource binding, multiple channels, provider writes, renewal, restarts, and durable retry pacing are outside this model.
